name: giggy-speech
description: Giggy text-to-speech and recorded-audio transcription tools for AI coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Use Giggy speech and recorded-audio transcription from AI agents. Discover voices, generate speech, submit recordings and retrieve durable results. MCP is not a live microphone transport. A Giggy account and authorized API access are required; paid modes incur usage charges.
defaultPrompt: Find available voices for a voice assistant.
Generate a short speech sample with Giggy.
Transcribe my authorised recording and retrieve the final transcript.
Check the status of my Giggy generation.
